name: Crow CI
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source CI/CD for self-hosted pipelines; no software-enforced build-minute or pipeline-run quotas, with Docker, Podman, Kubernetes and other agent backends.
watch_out: Self-hosted only: provide and pay for your own servers/runners, storage and networking; capacity and costs depend on your infrastructure. No managed free runner allowance is included.
